verdict.rationale: RingCentral's own docs list a Conversational Intelligence add-on that uses AI insights to understand calls, and an Agentic Voice AI platform that analyzes customer interactions end-to-end. That points to first-party AI call analysis, but neither item explicitly says calls get transcripts or summaries. The add-on also appears to be sold separately, not built in. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of call transcripts, AI-generated call summaries, those artifacts being attached to the conversation or call log record, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
